resources.string: Records taps, text changes (password values are never recorded), scrolls and screen changes for test automation. Data is only readable over ADB by the local Recorder Agent. Use on test devices with synthetic data only.

AI Mobile Test Studio Companion\n\nEnable the \"AI Mobile Test Studio Recorder\" accessibility service so the local Recorder Agent can capture UI interactions over ADB. Test devices and synthetic data only. Disable the service when not recording.
Transport: logcat tag AMTS_EVT, read only over USB/ADB by the Recorder Agent. This app has no INTERNET permission. Password values are never written.
